subject: Penetration follow-up: remediation digest & evidence handover (authz/logs/secrets/network)
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-analytics.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-security@acme-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 29 Jan 2026 08:34:12 -0800
Subject: Final evidence request for Dec '25 penetration test (scope ID PT-ACME-2025-12)

Hi David,

Thanks again for working with us on the December penetration test (PT-ACME-2025-12). We finished our internal review and need the following items to close our audit: per-finding remediation summaries and evidence for the high/critical findings listed below, an attestation that fixes are deployed to prod, and any SOC 2 scope updates you intend to make as a result.

High-level findings we need evidence for:
- A: Privilege escalation via excessive IAM role bindings (authz)
- B: Weak session handling and token expiry (authn)
- C: Missing audit records for admin routes (logging)
- D: Secrets found in a backup snapshot (secrets)
- E: Overly permissive security groups on internal subnets (network)

What we need from Redwood:
1) Short remediation summary per finding (one paragraph each)
2) Artifacts proving remediation (logs, configs, patch diffs) — consolidated archive preferred
3) ETA for each remaining item where work is still in progress
4) Signed attestation once you complete fixes and QA so we can close the ticket in our tracker

Can you get this to us by 2026-02-05? If any items need a change window or longer coordination, flag them and provide a clear timeline.

Appreciate the help — Jordan

--
Jordan Lee
Security Program Manager
Acme Analytics
jordan.lee@acme-analytics.com
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Jan 2026 11:10:02 -0800
Subject: Re: Final evidence request for Dec '25 penetration test (scope ID PT-ACME-2025-12)

Jordan — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Below is a concise remediation digest and the current status/ETA for each item. I will follow up with artifact links and the formal attestation once our internal QA completes.

Summary (high findings):
A) Privilege escalation (authz) — Status: FIXED (deployed)
- Remediation: Removed several broad role bindings, converted applicable roles to least-privilege scoped roles, added a policy that blocks cross-namespace role grant requests without approval.
- Evidence: 20260202-authz-fix-proof.log (diff and RBAC audit); Jira INF-7342.
- ETA: N/A (already deployed 2026-02-02 03:12 UTC)

B) Weak session handling (authn) — Status: PARTIAL (mitigations deployed, QA in progress)
- Remediation: Updated token expiry defaults from 30d -> 24h for non-service accounts, enforced refresh requirements in frontend SDK for interactive sessions.
- Evidence: session-test-run in logs, test vectors included in the archive.
- ETA for completion of QA and attestation: 2026-02-04 EOD

C) Missing audit records (logging) — Status: FIXED (deployed + backfilled)
- Remediation: Enabled admin-route audit logging, rotated logging pipeline rule to capture POST/DELETE operations, backfilled audit entries for the test window using S3 archived events.
- Evidence: 20260202-logging-audit.csv (sample of backfilled entries), CloudTrail links included in archive.
- ETA: N/A (deployed 2026-02-02 06:40 UTC)

D) Secrets in backup snapshot (secrets) — Status: FIXED (rotation completed)
- Remediation: Identified snapshot containing credentials, revoked impacted keys, rotated secrets, and updated backup retention/scan rules.
- Evidence: 20260202-secrets-rotation-report.txt (rotation report and runbook), KMS audit referenced.
- ETA: N/A (completed 2026-02-01)

E) Security groups (network) — Status: IN PROGRESS (requires maintenance window)
- Remediation: Patch to firewall policy prepared; requires coordination with networking change window to avoid connectivity impact for internal batch jobs.
- Evidence: patch diff attached (INF-7342-network-patch.diff), plan in Jira INF-7342.
- ETA: 2026-02-06 change window for full rollout (can provide constrained mitigation earlier if you need evidence sooner).

Artifact handoff plan:
- We will deliver a single signed archive containing logs, diffs, and the remediation checklist to your S3 share: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/acme/2026/20260202_remediation_bundle.zip (private presigned link, will rotate after delivery).
- Doc/links: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-remediation-checklist

Next steps from our side:
- Internal QA complete by 2026-02-04 EOD (authn), full archive delivered 2026-02-02 (partial artifacts already available), final attestation signed after network change window completes on 2026-02-06.

If you prefer, we can provide per-finding video walkthroughs or a short joint call to review evidence.

Thanks,
David

--
David Kim
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jan 2026 09:02:21 -0800
Subject: FW: Final evidence request for Dec '25 penetration test (PT-ACME-2025-12) — artifact upload + verification tasks

Marissa / Karthik / Neha — forwarding Jordan's ask and my reply. Action items below: please confirm by EOD 2026-02-03 that artifacts are uploaded to the S3 path and that the QA checklist items are green.

Action items:
- Marissa: build the archive (include authz diffs, logging csv samples, secrets rotation report) and upload to the S3 path. Name files exactly as in my reply. Provide presigned link and SHA256 checksum.
- Karthik: provide a short runbook for authn token changes + results of the session regression suite. Include test vectors used.
- Neha: coordinate the network change window — confirm whether we can schedule 2026-02-06 02:00-04:00 UTC for the firewall rule rollout. If that window is not acceptable for Acme, propose fallback mitigations and an earlier constrained evidence snapshot.

Notes: please include a one-paragraph QA note for each finding (did it pass, any residual risk, verification steps). Jordan is explicit that they need per-finding summaries, artifacts, and an attestation after we finish the network patch.

Thanks — will stitch everything and send the archive to Acme as soon as uploads are complete.

David
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Feb 2026 13:45:10 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Final evidence request — artifact upload + verification tasks

All — quick status update: artifacts uploaded and some timing notes below.

Uploads (S3): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/acme/2026/20260202_remediation_bundle.zip
- Included files: 20260202-authz-fix-proof.log, 20260202-logging-audit.csv, 20260202-secrets-rotation-report.txt, INF-7342-network-patch.diff
- Checksum (SHA256): 3f2b9c... (full value in S3 metadata)

QA notes (one-paragraph per finding):
- Authz: Verified RBAC diffs and replayed grant requests against the new policy; no privilege escalation path reproduced. PASS.
- Authn: Token expiry change validated against automated regression; one flaky test in mobile SDK (tracking ticket INF-7401) — mitigation applied, final QA expected 2026-02-04 EOD. PARTIAL.
- Logging: Backfill verification completed for the PT window; sample audit lines match expected events and include admin route POST/DELETE. PASS.
- Secrets: Rotation runbook executed, KMS audit shows revocation and re-issuance. PASS.
- Network: Patch ready; requires planned maintenance (2026-02-06 02:00-04:00 UTC). During the window, occasional internal job restarts expected; we will run smoke tests post-deploy. PENDING.

Notes on timeline: we can provide the current archive immediately to Acme (which includes proof for A/B/C/D); the network patch is the only outstanding item and will follow after the maintenance window.

If Jordan needs a constrained mitigation artifact for network sooner (e.g., trimmed security-group diff + planned firewall checks), we can extract that and push it today — confirm if you want that.

-Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-analytics.com>

Subject: Re: Final evidence request for Dec '25 penetration test (scope ID PT-ACME-2025-12)

David / team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the archive link. We reviewed the artifacts you uploaded and can confirm A/B/C/D are acceptable for our closure criteria. For item E (network), we accept your plan to perform the fix in the 2026-02-06 maintenance window — please send the signed attestation after the change is verified and include the smoke-test output for the impacted services.

For SOC 2 evidence intake we will:
- Mark A/B/C/D as closed in our tracker upon receipt of the signed attestation for authn (post-2026-02-04)
- Hold E open until we receive the post-change evidence and attestation

Please send the attestation PDF to acme-security@acme-analytics.com and cc me when ready. If anything blocks the 02/06 window, escalate and we can coordinate a joint change window.

Appreciate it — Jordan
